shots.content: In a quiet café seating area, the person in the emerald green knitted sweater with a high messy bun sits in the window-side seat nearest the tall floor plant, recounting an everyday mix-up with animated hand gestures. In the window-side seat nearest the café counter, the person in the mustard yellow button-down shirt with round tortoiseshell eyeglasses rests both hands on the table smiling with amusement, while the person in the charcoal grey denim jacket with short silver-streaked curls occupies the short-end seat directly in front of the tall floor plant, leaning back with a relaxed, cheerful expression.
shots.viewpoint: Wide view from the aisle-side corner, looking diagonally across the rectangular table. The full table and all three seats are visible.

shots.content: The person in the mustard yellow button-down shirt leans forward with an inquisitive grin to ask a teasing question, prompting the person in the emerald green knitted sweater to raise both hands in humorous surrender.
shots.viewpoint: Medium close view of the two people in the window-side seats.

shots.content: The person in the emerald green knitted sweater delivers the final comedic detail of the blunder with an open smile, while the person in the mustard yellow button-down shirt chuckles and shakes their head in delight.
shots.viewpoint: Wide view from the counter end, looking along the full table toward the floor plant. Both window-side seats and the plant-end seat are visible.
